from test.support import os_helper
import io
lengths = list(range(1, 257)) + [512, 1000, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 10000, 16384, 32768, 65536, 1000000]

def _t():

    def try_one(s):
        os_helper.unlink(os_helper.TESTFN)
        f = self.open(os_helper.TESTFN, 'wb')
        try:
            f.write(s)
            f.write(b'\n')
            f.write(s)
            f.close()
            f = self.open(os_helper.TESTFN, 'rb')
            line = f.readline()
            assert line == s + b'\n', ('assertEqual', line, s + b'\n')
            line = f.readline()
            assert line == s, ('assertEqual', line, s)
            line = f.readline()
            assert not line, ('assertFalse', line)
            f.close()
        finally:
            os_helper.unlink(os_helper.TESTFN)

    def drive_one(pattern):
        for length in lengths:
            q, r = divmod(length, len(pattern))
            teststring = pattern * q + pattern[:r]
            assert len(teststring) == length, ('assertEqual', len(teststring), length)
            try_one(teststring)
            try_one(teststring + b'x')
            try_one(teststring[:-1])

    class _SelfNS:
        pass
    self = _SelfNS()
    self.open = io.open
    _SelfNS.open = io.open
    drive_one(b'1234567890\x00\x01\x02\x03\x04\x05\x06')
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')
